I've saved the 3분기 answers to `/work/answer.json`. Applying the same method to 2분기 reproduced all 10 reference values exactly.

| 항목 | 값 |
|---|---|
| a. 순매출 1위 세그먼트 | `enterprise`, 283,065,969원 |
| b. 결제 완료 주문이 있는 고객 수 | 245 |

| e. 환불액 합계 1위 고객 | `u192@ex.com` (2,268,500원) |
| f. 결제 완료 주문 2건 이상 고객 수 | 232 |
| g. 주문당 평균 순매출 | 675,128원 |
| h. 8월 대비 9월 증가율 | 0.1% |

To match the 2분기 reference values, I had to handle three things in the data:
- **시간대:** `ordered_at` is stored in UTC (e.g. `...T15:30:00Z`). Quarter and month boundaries only matched the reference after converting to KST (UTC+9). With UTC dates, a, b, c, f, g and h all came out different.
- **고객 중복:** some emails belong to two customer ids. b and f only matched when customers were counted by email (trimmed and lowercased), not by id.
- **세그먼트 표기:** values like `' consumer'`, `'Enterprise '` and `'SMB'` were trimmed and lowercased so they merge into one segment each.

Two close calls, both checked with a separate join query:
- **d:** September (282,759,742원) beats August (282,428,710원) by only about 330,000원.
- **h:** the unrounded rate is 0.117%, so it rounds to 0.1.
